Hi, I'm Pinki Kumari. I'm a Software Development Engineer at Texas Instruments, where I build and maintain enterprise manufacturing and quality systems across backend and frontend services. I earned my M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering from IIT Gandhinagar (2022–2024) and work across Java, Spring Boot, React, and SQL, with hands-on experience in CI/CD, production support, and infrastructure operations.

I work under the supervision of [Prof. Anirban Dasgupta](https://sites.google.com/site/anirbandasgupta) on "Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) using Neural Tangent Kernels (NTKs)." I previously completed a two-month internship at [ThirdAI Corp.](https://www.thirdai.com/) focused on training and evaluation pipelines for Large Language Models on CPU.

## Experience

- **Software Development Engineer, Texas Instruments** *(Bengaluru, India — Aug 2024–Present)*  
  Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript, SQL, Jenkins, Linux, OKD, Git. Built and maintained backend and frontend components for enterprise manufacturing and quality systems, resolved production issues across services and data layers, and supported releases, operations, and certificate/Tomcat upgrades.
- **Summer Intern, ThirdAI Corp.** *(Hybrid — Jun–Jul 2023)*  
  Used ThirdAI’s Universal Deep Transformer (UDT) to pre-train, train, and fine-tune LLMs on CPUs and added evaluation pipelines for models such as BERT, LLaMA, and BOLT.
